verdictEs: Blitz si quieres overlay in-game rico con análisis post-match detallado y eres serio sobre coaching. Stryda si necesitas motivación extra y gamification de improvement con challenges diarios — el grind se vuelve más enganchador cuando hay goals concretos.
verdictEn: Blitz if you want a rich in-game overlay with detailed post-match analysis and you're serious about coaching. Stryda if you need extra motivation and improvement gamification with daily challenges — the grind becomes more engaging with concrete goals.

useCases.labelEs: Overlay in-game con enemy stats live
useCases.labelEn: In-game overlay with live enemy stats
useCases.reasonEs: Blitz tiene overlay más feature-rich con kill counter live, enemy stats al spawn, accuracy HUD. Stryda no tiene overlay capability, solo web app.
useCases.reasonEn: Blitz has a feature-rich overlay with live kill counter, enemy stats at spawn, accuracy HUD. Stryda has no overlay capability, only the web app.

useCases.labelEs: Motivar al grind diario con goals concretos
useCases.labelEn: Motivate daily grind with concrete goals
useCases.reasonEs: Stryda asigna challenges diarios y semanales que conviertan 'mejorar accuracy' en 'land 50 headshots con Wingman esta semana'. Blitz es puro analytics, no gamificación.
useCases.reasonEn: Stryda assigns daily and weekly challenges that turn 'improve accuracy' into 'land 50 headshots with Wingman this week'. Blitz is pure analytics, no gamification.

useCases.reasonEs: Blitz produce summaries detalladas con breakdown por weapon, accuracy por engagement, identifica moments específicos de mistakes. Stryda's analytics son más superficiales.
useCases.reasonEn: Blitz produces detailed summaries with per-weapon breakdown, per-engagement accuracy, identifies specific mistake moments. Stryda's analytics are more superficial.

useCases.labelEs: Compartir progress y compete con friends
useCases.labelEn: Share progress and compete with friends
useCases.reasonEs: Stryda tiene system de challenges social — compará completions con amigos, tournaments community. Blitz es individual-focused sin layer social.
useCases.reasonEn: Stryda has a social challenge system — compare completions with friends, community tournaments. Blitz is individual-focused without a social layer.

useCases.labelEn: Minimal setup with no learning curve
useCases.reasonEs: Stryda es web-first: cuenta gratuita, link Apex, listo. Blitz requiere install de app desktop con configuración inicial de 5 minutos.
useCases.reasonEn: Stryda is web-first: free account, link Apex, done. Blitz requires desktop app install with 5-minute initial configuration.
